description: This source file defines API client functions for a frontend dashboard. It provides mechanisms to resolve the API base URL, fetch JSON data from various endpoints related to dashboard modules, overview metrics, deployments, users, and costs. It exports functions to retrieve modules overview and summary metrics.

methods.name: resolveBase()
methods.description: Determines the API base URL based on environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, { credentials = 'include' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from the specified URL with error handling, default credentials, and content-type validation.

methods.name: toArray(data)
methods.description: Normalizes incoming data shapes into an array for consistent processing.

methods.name: getModules()
methods.description: Fetches dashboard module overviews from specific API endpoints, or derives summarized data from deployments, users, and costs if endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics()
methods.description: Fetches and returns consolidated total users and deployed applications metrics for dashboard overview.
